Caitlyn

the Sheriff of Piltover

Caitlyn has the longest basic attack range of any marksman. She bullies the lane with free auto-attacks and traps, takes turrets early, and turns any enemy mistake into a big Headshot. A great pick if you like aggressive, safe-range laning.

When to pick Caitlyn

✓ Safe blind pick

Yes. Her huge range lets her farm safely and bully most lanes, so she's a solid blind pick.

Pick into

  • Short-range marksmen she can bully, like Vayne and Ezreal
  • Immobile teams that walk into her traps
  • Games where you want to take plates and towers early
  • Passive lanes that let her farm and push

Avoid into

  • Long-range lanes that trade back, like Ziggs and Jhin
  • Hyper-scaling marksmen, like Kog'Maw, who out-damage her late
  • Teams with lots of dive and engage that reach her

Great teammates

NamiNami's bubble sets up traps and headshots.
BlitzcrankBlitzcrank's hook pulls a target onto a trap.
ThreshThresh adds crowd control for traps and peel.

Your team needs: Pick Caitlyn when your team wants to win lane early and siege towers.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge attack range: she can hit most marksmen without being hit back
  • Traps and net combos give strong Headshots and lock down targets
  • Excellent at taking turret plates and towers early
  • Net (E) gives her a short escape

Weaknesses

  • Her damage falls off a little in the late game compared to hyper-carries
  • If she falls behind early, her lane bully plan doesn't work
  • Weak against champions who can reach her with dashes or engage
  • Ace in the Hole can be blocked by an enemy stepping in front

Power spikes

  • Level 1-3: Your range lets you poke the enemy for free; win the lane early
  • Level 6: Ace in the Hole finishes anyone who escapes with low health
  • First item (Hexoptics C44): longer range damage and bonus range after takedowns
  • Two items (Infinity Edge): Headshots start dealing huge damage
  • Three items (Lord Dominik's Regards): you can shred tanky frontliners

Top tips

  • Stand in brush to charge Headshot faster
  • Place a trap on an enemy who is stunned or rooted: it triggers instantly
  • Net plus auto-attack gives an instant Headshot from long range
  • Use your range to hit the enemy every time they walk up to last-hit
  • Keep a trap or two near you during sieges so divers get caught
  • Fire Ace in the Hole only when no enemy can step in front of the target
